preconditions.description: Number of vertices V is between 1 and 10^4.
Number of edges E is between 0 and 10^4.
The length of the adjacency list adj is equal to the number of vertices V.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V for u in range(V))
preconditions.description: All nodes are labeled with integers in the range 0 to V-1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= v < V for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: All edges in the adjacency list point to valid nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, int) for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the returned list are integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= node < V for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the returned list are within the range 0 to V-1.

postconditions.expression: all(node in return_value for node in range(V) if all(v in return_value for v in adj[node]))
postconditions.description: All safe nodes are included in the returned list.
The returned list is sorted in ascending order.
